description: Na₃Sb(PO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.89 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SbO₅ square pyramid, corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one SbO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.60 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.51 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.74 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.66 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.79 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted SbO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 87°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.59 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted SbO₅ square pyramids that share corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.51 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SbO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-39°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.63 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three SbO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-64°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.60 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three SbO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.61 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.62 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and one P atom to form distorted ONa₄P square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄P square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₃P trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₄P square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃P trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃P trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom.
